cases.name: Alexandra “Alex” Paz
cases.about:
She served in the Marines, training at Parris Island in South Carolina. Rosetta Kelley, Alex's mother, says that "she lights up the room when she walks in. Her smile, she always has a happy smile."

Kelley says that Alex loved animals and was just about finished with her college courses and training to become a veterinary technician.
